title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Ontario Secondary School Applicants
Decisions on admission to Year 1 will
normally be based on completion of the Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD)
and a minimum of six 4U and/or 4M
courses
.
Laurier will use the top six grades from these
courses
when calculating the
admission average, unless otherwise noted. An overall average of 70% from these
six courses is the minimum requirement for admissions consideration.
However, a higher average will be required for admission to individual
programs
in which the demand for places by qualified applicants exceeds the
supply of places available in those programs.
All programs require a minimum final
overall average of 70.0% unless otherwise stated (as some may require higher
final averages). This is outlined on the applicants' official Offer of
Admission.
NOTE:
A 4U English at a minimum of 60% is required for all
programs
at
Laurier unless otherwise specified. Applicants must also meet program-specific
requirements; all required courses, listed below, must be at a minimum of 60%
unless otherwise specified.
The length of time taken by an applicant to complete the OSSD will not
of itself be a determining factor in the admission decision.
Grade IX
Practical combined with grade III Harmony, RCM,
or the equivalent, will be accepted as 4M music credit for admission.
Submit appropriate documentation to your high school for official conversion
.
Wilfrid
Laurier University adheres to the guidelines of the Ministry of Education and
Training.
It is
expected that secondary schools will report students' standing to the
university through the Ontario Universities Application Centre (OUAC) in
terms
of percentage marks for admission and scholarship selection purposes.
A student who receives an offer of admission based on grade 11, early or
mid-term grades, and whose final grades have already been submitted, must still
meet final conditions, as stated on their Offer of Admission. The University
reserves the right to withdraw its Offer of Admission if these requirements are
not completely satisfied. We are continuously sending out offers of admission
from the time applications open on the OUAC in October, until late May. Offers
are sent out on a rolling basis, based on different academic criteria.
